text:
Diego (Eng): Heads-up: I'll be in Dubai for ~60 days (2027-11-01 to 2027-12-30). Want to confirm WFH stipend handling, health coverage, and any payroll/tax flags.
Maya (People Ops): Thanks Diego. Under our temp remote policy <=90 days usually ok but UAE has some paperwork for longer stays. Are you planning to work typical hours? Any customer meetings?
Diego (Eng): Standard overlap hours, no customers, no local contracting.
Ibrahim (Payroll): For stipend we can prorate the monthly WFH allowance across Nov/Dec payroll runs and mark as taxable. UAE has no personal income tax, but our payroll records still need the temporary address.
Riya (Tax): Confirming: UAE has no personal income tax, so employee withholding isn't an issue. Employer withholding for social schemes isn't applicable for non-resident foreign payroll. Still, document dates and purpose. If you accept local employment or start hiring contractors there, escalate.
Maya (People Ops): Good. Diego please complete /forms/temp-remote with address, emergency contact, and insurance preference. Also state if you'll use Redwood travel insurance or arrange local coverage.
peopleops-bot: Reminder: Fill /forms/temp-remote within 48h to avoid delays. :memo:
Diego (Eng): I'll use Redwood travel insurance for emergencies only. I'll fill the form tonight.
Ibrahim (Payroll): Action: once form submitted, payroll will schedule prorated stipend for 2027-11-30 and 2027-12-30 pay runs and add note "Temp Dubai stay" to record.
Riya (Tax): Keep travel itineraries and proof of temporary stay (airbnb/booking receipts). If you extend beyond 90 days or do client-facing meetings, ping tax@redwood.com.
Maya (People Ops): Approved provisional. Diego, let us know if your visa type requires employer reporting — we can advise.
Diego (Eng): No visa changes expected, tourist visa covers my stay. Thanks team.
Ibrahim (Payroll): Posted: stipend scheduled for Nov and Dec payroll.
peopleops-bot: Temp Remote Request logged (ID #TR-2027-331).
Maya (People Ops): I'll attach TR-2027-331 to Diego's people record and close thread once payroll confirms entries.
Diego (Eng): Confirmed form submitted. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
